posts.title: The Dependency You Could Never Replace
posts.description: Resilience plans assume the thing comes back. Sovereignty is the discipline of asking what happens if it does not. posts.title: The Spare Tire Problem: Why Organizations Are Built for the Day Nothing Breaks
